name: Block Cover
description: Blocks of a solid color pop in at random over the first clip until they cover the frame, then pop out in another random order to show the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: blocks
params.description: Number of blocks along the longer side of the frame (the blocks stay about square)

params.name: pop
params.description: How much a block overshoots its cell as it pops in

params.name: smoothness
params.description: Softness of the blocks' edges, in blocks
